summary: Added the password rules to the sign-up page: the five rules render as hint text under the password field, and on submit each unmet rule produces its own error line in a single alert list, checked before the existing match/duplicate-email checks. Rules and `passwordErrors` are exported from `Signup.jsx`.
conventions: Sign-up passwords must be >= 8 characters and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number and one special character (any non-alphanumeric); each unmet rule is reported as its own error line.

visual_check.evidence: The signup page shows a bulleted rule list directly under the Password field listing all five rules (8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, special character), styled as hint text within the card.

context_sharing.notes: There is no HTTP API here: signup persists entirely to localStorage under the key 'acme-users' (keyed by lowercased, trimmed email) via saveUser/findUser in src/store.js, with the session pointer in sessionStorage key 'acme-current'. Client-side routes used are '/login' (navigate and Link target); no network endpoints exist to consume.
